articles.title: Crypto is going through a massive dot-com style shakeout as over 100 projects fold in 2026
articles.snippet: An industry-wide reckoning is weeding out unsustainable startups, leaving behind only the protocols with real cash flow and actual users.

articles.title: Bitcoin holders risk losing real BTC if they sell coins from BIP-110 fork, says developer
articles.snippet: If a minority chain appears this weekend, buyers could replay signed fork-coin sales on bitcoin itself, making doing nothing the safest move until the chains can be separated.

articles.title: Bitcoin will never fall below $60K again: Nansen founder
articles.snippet: Crypto is growing up thanks to trading in real world assets, and Bitcoin will never dip below $60K again, says Nansen founder founder Alex Svanevik.
